class.name: GameplaySessionManager
class.brief_description: Authoritative connection state machine and reconnectable session owner.
class.description: GameplaySessionManager is transport-independent. A server adapter must call each phase in order: [method transport_connected], [method verify_version], [method authenticate], [method admit], [method create_player], and [method spawn_player]. Disconnects deactivate the PlayerState and retain session objects until the grace period expires.

method.name: admit
method.description: Advances an authenticated connection through business admission.

method.name: authenticate
method.description: Binds trusted authentication output to a new or inactive stable session.

method.name: create_player
method.description: Creates or rebinds PlayerState and Controller after admission.

method.name: expire_disconnected
method.description: Destroys sessions whose grace periods elapsed and returns the count removed.

method.name: get_active_session_count
method.description: Returns the number of sessions with live peer bindings.

method.name: get_connection
method.description: Returns the live connection for a peer.

method.name: get_session
method.description: Returns a session by stable identity.

method.name: get_session_by_peer
method.description: Returns the session currently bound to a peer.

method.name: get_sessions
method.description: Returns all active and grace-period sessions.

method.name: reject
method.description: Marks a connection rejected with a machine-readable reason.

method.name: shutdown
method.description: Stops admission and removes every connection and session.

method.name: spawn_player
method.description: Creates and possesses a Pawn after player creation.

method.name: transport_connected
method.description: Begins state tracking for a new transport peer.

method.name: transport_disconnected
method.description: Deactivates the peer's session and begins its reconnect grace period.

method.name: verify_version
method.description: Validates the application protocol version before authentication.

members.member: Whether new transport peers may enter the state machine.
How long disconnected sessions remain reconnectable.
The authority used for player creation and removal.
The exact accepted application protocol version.

signal.name: connection_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted for every accepted phase transition.

signal.name: session_created
signal.description: Emitted for a new stable session.

signal.name: session_deactivated
signal.description: Emitted when a session enters its grace period.

signal.name: session_expired
signal.description: Emitted immediately before an expired session is destroyed.

signal.name: session_rebound
signal.description: Emitted when an inactive session binds a new peer.
